This has reference to SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DOF2/P/CIR/2022/69 dated May 23, 2022 (hereafter referred as “circular”) and subsequent addendum Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DF2/CIR/P/2022/102 dated July 28, 2022 on development of passive funds. 2.
